turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm planning a surprise party for my best friend's thirtieth and I have a few ideas.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait until I've listed everything before you jump in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is renting the back room of her favorite restaurant for a dinner with about twenty people.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another option is a house party at my place with music and lots of snacks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could plan a smaller weekend trip with just her five closest friends.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all. Which sounds best to you?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The restaurant dinner feels special and you don't have to clean up after. A house party is cheaper and more relaxed, but you'd be busy hosting. The weekend trip is the most memorable, though it's harder to keep a surprise when people need to plan time off.
